messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.14-2
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.14-2) has been released at its web site
(http://www.rqtl.org).

The changes (see http://www.rqtl.org/STATUS.txt) were extremely minor,
and are just to prepare for a change in the grep() function in the
upcoming version of R.

Karl Broman
kbr...@biostat.wisc.edu
